name: retry-duplicate
description: Two sessions independently add retry/backoff logic to different files in the same project -- duplicate construction the semantic comparator should flag once both sessions have registered their designs (the design gate's first-edit deny prompts that).

a.label: A
a.goal: In src/net/http-client.ts, make requestJson retry a failed request a few times with an increasing delay between attempts (exponential backoff) before giving up. Write a small helper for computing the delay if that's useful. Keep the change small and focused. When you're done, briefly summarize what you changed.

b.label: B
b.goal: In src/queue/worker.ts, make processJob retry a failed job a few times with a backoff delay between attempts before giving up and logging the failure. Write a small helper for computing the delay if that's useful. Keep the change small and focused. When you're done, briefly summarize what you changed.
